title: Retire revoked pulse and timer Host Call owners into retained providers
body:
The environmental native worker must eventually return its actual GPIO/timer providers to Root after attributed quiescence so a later separately admitted Play can use them. Current pulse and monotonic-wait Host Call owners expose revocation/inspection but no consuming retirement path. Dropping or cloning provider descriptions is not a lawful custody transfer.

Scope: add a consuming, allocation-free retirement boundary to these two native Host Call owner types, preserving the retained owner on refusal. It returns only the actual provider and its attachment after capability lifecycle is Revoked and in-flight operations are zero. Issued/exhausted possession does not imply retirement. Returned providers carry no capability table, handle, claim, or permission for a new Play. Root must separately admit any subsequent installation and binding.

Acceptance: live possession refuses without losing custody; explicit revocation permits exact provider/attachment recovery once; cancellation drops provider work and retires only after zero in-flight; empty retained slots refuse; wrong-binding revocation cannot enable retirement. Do not claim this alone implements worker rearming, resource generation advancement, a second Play, owner-loss recovery, or recording.


## Independent combined CPU acceptance proof (2026-10-24 UTC)

The [retained combined proof packet](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/6023aa29805ab099e685eb1c3722e6f4907b0238/evidence/6334-combined-retirement) records execution at test source `1d62af38d72b6a7117c30554d7d9af5562278066`, combining delivered pulse source from devdd3cdb41f with timer candidatecc527bec2 and separate generic regression tests. Only test files differ from the clean combined production source. Both strict all-target Clippy checks passed; pulse Host Call tests passed12cases and timer tests passed12cases. Raw commands/logs and exact source correspondence are retained in the packet.

New public-API tests use actual one-operation budgets (and an independently retained one-count timer configuration). Each observes completed1/in-flight0/Exhausted, verifies retirement returnsNotRevoked without moving or changing the retained owner, confirms another request causes no second provider effect, then explicitly revokes and recovers the exact provider/attachment once. Empty-slot refusal and zero allocations/reallocations are checked. Existing tests retain issued/live refusal, wrong-binding revocation refusal and cancellation quiescence before provider recovery.

Pulse PR #6344 is delivered by squashdd3cdb41f after successful exact-head Candidate40043455270; the exact before/after blobs were audited. Timer delivery and applicable successful combined Integration remain to be verified. This local CPU proof does not close the issue or claim physical installation, rearming, resource-generation advancement, another Play, owner-loss recovery or recording. The new test additions remain separately reviewable on `proof/6334-combined-retirement-20261024`; neither implementation PR source was changed by this proof work.


## Current omnibus admission (2026-10-24 UTC)

Both reviewed provider production trees and the actual one-operation Exhausted/refusal/revocation regressions are now retained in the omnibus. Source5ace passed12 timer tests and14 Pulse tests with host-call+plot-catalog, plus strict lint; production provider blobs remain unchanged at currentd677. The delivery still requires both providers in accepteddev and applicable successful Integration. This remains CPU cooperative ownership/recovery proof, not physical hardware, rearming or a new Play grant.

Current delivery source is `d677b25383b22ca2911f1ec49936ca7b4a3c86ee` in existing PR #6339, with fresh [Candidate40054154999](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/actions/runs/40054154999). No additional PR was opened. [Current registry repair, exact positive test and preflight proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/d43f2818a0143dcdb81ee319ee11c975a578f5cc/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-lock-registry-20261024/d677b2538); [source-qualified production/Face proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/dc6cdb60a0214d50c05b3396b0f862c02e0354d7/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-final-20261024/eacbd8350). Full exact-head Candidate, actual dev delivery, applicable Integration and final scoped audits remain required; no issue closure from these local checks.
